# qualys_scan_schedules (Data Source)

Look up Qualys scan schedules, for auditing schedules managed outside
Terraform or referencing them from other configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "qualys_scan_schedules" "weekly" {
  title_contains = "Weekly"
}

output "weekly_schedule_ids" {
  value = [for s in data.qualys_scan_schedules.weekly.scan_schedules : s.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- **id** (String) The ID of this resource.
- **id_filter** (String) Restrict the lookup to a single schedule ID.
- **title_contains** (String) Filter results to schedules whose title contains this substring (case-insensitive). Applied client-side, after the API call.

### Read-Only

- **scan_schedules** (List of Object) Matching scan schedules, ordered by ID for stable output. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scan_schedules))
